'''Kaya''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] operating during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]], she was part of a crew that made a run to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]], and was the only survivor after they were attacked by the native [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. Fleeing from a [[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], she and her droid [[D0-M9]] headed to [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].
